meta.title: Geo & Tax Mapping Master: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Reach and operate the Geo & Tax Mapping Master, including city, state, country, zone, tax mappings, and pincode autofill
Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify the action is refused or absent
Sign in as a Tenant Admin in the same tenant and verify the action is available
Compare the two users' access under identical tenant configuration
